name: Sunshine Coast Holiday Builder 🌊
heroTagline: Golden beaches, hinterland charm, and laid-back family fun — Queensland's original coastal playground.

region.description: A perfect blend of stunning beaches, lush hinterland, and family-friendly attractions — from Australia Zoo to Mooloolaba's pristine shoreline. More relaxed than the Gold Coast but packed with holiday memories.

areas.name: Maroochydore
areas.description: Central hub with Sunshine Plaza shopping, Cotton Tree Park, and Maroochydore patrolled beach. Great central base for exploring.

areas.name: Mooloolaba
areas.description: The Sunshine Coast's most popular beach town — SEA LIFE aquarium, Wharf dining, and one of Australia's best beaches.

areas.name: Caloundra
areas.description: Southern Sunshine Coast with family beaches, Kings Beach water fountain, and laid-back coastal charm. Close to Australia Zoo.

areas.name: Coolum Beach
areas.description: Relaxed beach town with great surfing, coastal walking tracks, and a friendly village atmosphere. Quieter than Mooloolaba.

areas.name: Noosa Heads (nearby)
areas.description: Day-trip to iconic Hastings Street, Noosa Main Beach, and Noosa National Park. Queensland's most glamorous beach town.

areas.name: Sunshine Coast Hinterland
areas.description: Maleny, Montville, and the Glass House Mountains — lush rainforest, waterfalls, farms, and stunning mountain views.

areas.name: Beerwah
areas.description: Home of Australia Zoo — the Crocodile Hunter's legacy lives on in this iconic wildlife park.

areas.name: Yandina
areas.description: Home of the iconic Ginger Factory and nearby artisan food producers.

driving.parkingNote: Beachfront parking fills fast in peak season. Arrive by 9am. Paid parking at Mooloolaba Wharf ($). Most accommodations include free parking.

airportTransfer.familyShuttle: Approx. $60-$90 family return from Sunshine Coast Airport to Mooloolaba.
airportTransfer.rideShare: Approx. $35-$50 from Sunshine Coast Airport to Mooloolaba.

meta.priceAccuracyNote: All prices and costs are estimates generated on 2026-07-12. Availability and final pricing must be confirmed with each provider. The Sunshine Coast Holiday Builder does not sell tickets, take bookings, or hold money.
